page.layout: One printed page: running head at top, then the title in the centre; below it an engraving with a hourglass and wreath, then four lines of italic verse in the centre-left; a catchword at the right below the verse.

main_text.head: OMNIA TEMPVS HABENT.
main_text.p: [Engraving: a wreath enclosing an hourglass with wings, under a sun in a cloudy sky, with a hill and a building at the right.]

l.i: Nexuit, vt fiant tempore quæq; suo:
Temporibus seruire decet, decet omnia Καιρῷ[?]

page.notes: The small Greek word printed after "omnia" in the third verse line is hard to read; I have given my best reading with [?]. The engraving is described only. The catchword "Sapien-" is at the right below the last line.
